_readme: Pokédex of Pokémon Pitch Black 2. Every Pokémon appears ONCE. 'evo' = {from, method}: the Pokémon it evolves from and how. The page builds the boxes by itself: one box per final evolution (split evolutions = one box each, e.g. Vileplume and Bellossom both contain Oddish and Gloom); Paradox Pokémon get their own box with only the Pokémon they come from ('paradox.from'); alternate forms ('form_of', e.g. Rotom (Heat)) sit inside the box of their base form. 'changed' = true if the Pokémon is different from vanilla Black 2/White 2. 'sprite' only when the image is not the default one (PokeAPI Black/White sprite {pokedex_id}.png), e.g. regional forms.
